title: petal doc --json
description: The documented public surface of a Petal package, module or file, as `petal doc --json` prints it (docs/CLI.md, `doc`; docs/proposals/doc-annotation.md). Signatures come from the declarations, prose from @doc(...) and @module_doc(...). A comment is never documentation: an item without @doc has "doc": null.

schema.description: The report format. Changes when a consumer would have to read it differently.

target.description: The argument as given: a package (`ui`), a module (`ui/input`), a file or a package directory.

package.description: The package the documented modules belong to; null for a loose file or a module registered in memory (the core prelude `std`).

modules.description: Every module of the package in module order, or the one module asked for.

description.description: `[package] description` in petal.toml: the one-line registry summary.

root.description: The package root directory, or `<bundled:NAME>` / `<package:NAME>` for a package held in memory.

root_module.description: The module named like the package (`ui`, `core`), whose @module_doc is the package's doc.

doc.description: The root module's @module_doc: the package's documentation.

modules.description: Every module of the package, by canonical name.

name.description: The canonical module name (`ui/draw`, `bloom`), or the path given for a loose file.

file.description: The module's file: relative to the package root for a package module, as given for a loose file, `<memory:NAME>` for one registered in memory.

canonical.description: The canonical name of the module it re-exports; null for a relative path in a loose file.

names.description: The names re-exported (`pub import m: a, b`); null for all of them.

items.description: The module's items in source order; an overload set appears once, where its first form is.

error.description: Present when the module does not parse; its items are then empty and `petal doc` exits 1.

kind.description: `native_fn` when every form is a `native fn`; `fn` otherwise.

name.description: The name it binds; `Class.method` for a method.

hidden.description: The item's doc says `hidden: true`: left out of `--brief`, the default text and generated reference pages.

line.description: The line of the (first) declaration keyword, past its annotations.

doc.description: The item's doc. For an overload set, the doc of its first documented form; each form also carries its own.

receiver.description: For a method (`fn Rect.area`), the class.

forms.description: How it is called: each overload of a function, or a class's constructor.

fields.description: A class's fields, in constructor order.

type.description: A binding's declared type, when written.

value.description: A binding's initializer as written, when it fits on one line (80 characters).

native.description: A `native fn`: the host implements it.

host.description: The host native a `native fn ... = "name"` binds.

optional.description: A call may leave it out: it has a default, is a native's `name?`, or is a rest parameter.

default.description: The default value's source text (`fn f(a, b = 2)`).

rest.description: A native's `...name`: any number of further arguments.

doc.description: A @doc(...) or @module_doc(...): every field, with the body and examples cleaned of a raw string's shared indentation and blank first and last lines.

summary.description: The body's first sentence, on one line.

params.description: `params:`, by parameter name, in source order.

options.description: `options:`: the keys a trailing style/opts record accepts.

example.description: Petal source, shown as code, not run.

extra.description: `extra:`, passed through: any literal (string, number, bool, null, or a list or record of them).
